name: PerkLab/SlicerOpenAnatomy
what_it_is: A 3D Slicer extension that exports segmentation and model hierarchy data to glTF/OBJ files compatible with the Open Anatomy Project browser, and provides an atlas editor for merging or removing anatomical label groups using a JSON hierarchy schema.
components: OpenAnatomyExport module — exports segmentation to glTF, OBJ, or scene format with mesh decimation
AtlasEditor module — loads atlas labelmap + color table + structure JSON, merges or removes label groups
constraints: Requires 3D Slicer as host; cannot run standalone
glTF export converts to PBR causing slight appearance differences
AtlasEditor input must be labelmap .nrrd + color table + JSON structure
OBJ export does not preserve hierarchy or model names
